# S337 — wave start launches without --yes when stdin is not a terminal

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**2026-11-11** — Correction 2026-11-11: the slices were NOT launched. The run in the ledger (run-20261111-170605-e94e) held only a spec-check step, which ended pass at 17:07:58; the CLI was killed by the 60 s timeout before any launch. So the observed problem is narrower: without --yes and with stdin from /dev/null, `ork wave start` starts and records a spec-check run (a model call) before any confirmation and prints nothing while it runs. Expected: print the plan first, and run nothing that costs a model call until confirmed, or say on stderr that a spec check is running.

trust: unverified; by: Jon Robbins

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Observed 2026-11-11 (slicer wave): `ork wave start slicer s454 s455 s450 s456 s451 --implementer claude:sonnet:high --reviewer grok:grok-4.7:medium --architect off </dev/null` (no --yes) printed nothing for 60 s and was killed by timeout; `ork status` then showed run-20261111-170605-e94e active with a spec-check running. The same command before the project had a check command printed the plan and refused. Expected: without --yes and with no terminal to confirm on, print the plan and exit without launching (or refuse), never launch silently.
